title: 阿克尚·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 后梳深发衬着整齐短须，长款浅色围巾延伸出轻盈轮廓。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Akshan is an adult Shuriman adventurer with warm brown skin, swept dark hair, a short neat beard, lively eyes, and a long pale scarf. Preserve his agile human proportions and ornate golden Sentinel details. His torso is fully covered by a closed cream tunic and short jacket above opaque trousers and boots; his distinctive grappling firearm is carried lowered and inactive.
art_direction.scene: A composed near-profile study with a gentle head turn, signature forms stacked into a tall diagonal, luminous rim and airy negative space. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: sand gold, ivory scarf, turquoise, indigo shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
